item.title: Lee: "Our Capability to Defend Ourselves Is More Than Enough, Accelerate Nuclear Submarine Project" (李 “우리 지킬 역량 차고 넘친다, 핵잠 사업에 속도”)
item.description:
Lee: "Our Capability to Defend Ourselves Is More Than Enough, Accelerate Nuclear Submarine Project" (李 “우리 지킬 역량 차고 넘친다, 핵잠 사업에 속도”)

President Lee Jae-myung said on the 18th, "We must push forward the return of wartime operational control within my term without disruption, in accordance with the original government plan." President Lee made these remarks at the Ulchi State Council meeting held at the presidential office on the first day of the "Ulchi Freedom Shield" exercise, a regular South Korea-U.S. joint drill, saying, "In terms of weapons systems and force size, our capability to defend ourselves already ranks among the top few in the world. It would be no exaggeration to say it is more than sufficient." (이재명 대통령은 18일 “전시 작전권의 임기 내 환수를 당초 정부 계획에 따라서 차질 없이 추진해 나가야겠다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 한미 정례 연합 훈련인 ‘을지 자유의 방패’ 훈련 첫날 청와대에서 개최된 을지 국무회의에서 “무기 체계와 전력 규모 측면에서 보면 이미 우리 스스로를 지킬 역량이 전 세계적으로 몇 번째 안에 들 정도다. 차고 넘친다고 해도 과언이 아닐 정도”라며 이같이 말했다.)

President Lee also said, "I ask that we accelerate the pursuit of the nuclear-powered submarine project, which will symbolize a more constructive and robust future for the South Korea-U.S. alliance." He added, "Only when the alliance is strong will the foundation of our security become firmer, and by strengthening our own capabilities, our value and necessity as an ally will grow even greater." (이 대통령은 또 “보다 건설적이고 굳건한 한미 동맹의 미래를 상징할 핵 잠수함 사업 추진에 속도를 내주기 바란다“고 했다. “동맹이 굳건해야 안보의 근간이 더 튼튼해질 것이고, 우리 자신의 힘을 키워야 동맹으로서 가치와 필요성이 더 커진다”고도 했다.)

President Lee's remarks came amid signs of friction in security and trade, including U.S. President Donald Trump's directive to drastically reduce South Korea-U.S. joint exercises, and ongoing differences between the two countries over the Coupang incident and the implementation of U.S. investment commitments. While South Korea and the U.S. have been discussing issues such as Korea's uranium enrichment and reprocessing and the construction of nuclear-powered submarines, they have failed to schedule follow-up talks after the first meeting was held in June. (이 대통령의 발언은 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 한미 연합 훈련의 대폭 축소를 지시하고, 쿠팡 사태와 대미(對美) 투자 이행에서 양국 입장차가 이어지는 등 안보와 통상에서 갈등 조짐이 보이는 가운데 나왔다. 한미는 한국의 원자력 연료 농축·재처리, 원자력 추진 잠수함 건조 등을 협의하고 있지만, 지난 6월 1차 회의를 진행한 후 후속 협의 일정을 못 잡고 있다.)

On the issue of establishing an integrated ROK Armed Forces Academy, which faces strong public opposition, President Lee said, "To prepare for future warfare where the distinction between battlefields has become meaningless, we must also cultivate officers with integrated operational capabilities," adding, "Please proceed with preparations for the establishment of the Armed Forces Academy without wavering." (이 대통령은 이날 반대 여론이 거센 통합 국군사관학교 창설 문제에 대해 “전장의 구분이 무의미해진 미래전에 대비하려면 통합적 작전 능력을 갖춘 간부도 길러내야 한다”며 “국군사관학교 창설 준비 또한 흔들림 없이 진행해 달라”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee will meet with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi at the presidential office on the 20th. Foreign Minister Wang will visit South Korea on a two-day schedule from the 19th to the 20th, and will hold a South Korea-China foreign ministers' meeting with Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul on the 19th. The presidential office stated that President Lee will assess the direction of South Korea-China relations and regional circumstances during his meeting with Minister Wang. Given that President Lee proposed a "multilateral discussion on ending the war" in his Liberation Day commemorative address on the 15th, there is a possibility that opinions will be exchanged on this matter. Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to North Korea in June and his planned visit to the U.S. in September are also expected to be topics of discussion. Following the meeting with President Lee, National Security Office Director Shin Won-sik will hold talks and a luncheon with Minister Wang. (한편, 이 대통령은 오는 20일 청와대에서 왕이(王毅) 중국 외교부장을 접견한다. 왕 부장은 19~20일 일정으로 방한해 19일 조현 외교부 장관과 한중 외교장관 회담을 가질 예정이다. 이 대통령은 왕 부장과 접견에서 한중 관계 발전 방향과 지역 정세 등에 대해 평가할 예정이라고 청와대는 밝혔다. 이 대통령이 지난 15일 광복절 경축사를 통해 ‘종전 다자 논의’를 제안한 만큼, 이와 관련한 의견 교환이 이뤄질 가능성도 있다. 6월 시진핑 주석의 북한 방문, 9월 시진핑 중국 주석의 방미 등도 화제에 오를 전망이다. 이 대통령과 접견 후엔 위성락 국가안보실장이 왕 부장과 회담 및 오찬을 진행한다.)

Minister Wang visited South Korea last year as part of the delegation for the APEC summit in Gyeongju, but this will be the first visit by a Chinese foreign minister to South Korea for a South Korea-China foreign ministers' meeting in five years, since 2021. Since the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration, no U.S. or Japanese foreign minister has yet visited South Korea independently. In diplomatic circles, there is talk that a Chinese foreign minister's visit to South Korea during the South Korea-U.S. joint exercises is unusual. (왕 부장은 지난해 경주 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 수행단으로 방한했지만, 중국 외교부장이 한중 외교장관 회담을 위해 방한하는 것은 2021년 이후 5년 만이다. 이재명 정부 출범 후 미국과 일본 외교장관은 아직까지 단독 방한하지 않았다. 외교가에선 한미 연합 훈련 시기 중국 외교부장의 방한이 이례적이라는 말도 나온다.)

item.title: Jung Sung-ho Submits Resignation... President Lee Signals Acceptance (정성호 사직서 제출… 李대통령 수용 의사)
item.description:
Jung Sung-ho Submits Resignation... President Lee Signals Acceptance (정성호 사직서 제출… 李대통령 수용 의사)

Justice Minister Jung Sung-ho submitted his resignation to the presidential office on the 18th. The presidential office stated it would accept his resignation, while "asking him to fulfill his duties until a successor is appointed." Minister Jung had previously expressed his intention to step down multiple times, citing health reasons. In his resignation letter, he reportedly cited health issues along with the rationale that "major legislation related to prosecution reform has been completed." He intends to step down now that bills such as the abolition of the prosecution service, the establishment of a prosecution office and a serious crimes investigation agency, and the removal of prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers have been processed. <<> However, in political circles, speculation has arisen that he chose to resign due to the burden of the potential revocation of indictments in President Lee Jae-myung's cases. The Ministry of Justice launched the Prosecution Human Rights and Future Committee in June, vowing to investigate suspicions of prosecutorial abuse, and recently placed six cases involving President Lee—where indictment revocation is possible—under review. The results are expected to be released as early as next month. A ruling camp official said, "With the newly elected pro-Lee representative Kim Min-seok of the Democratic Party mentioning the need for indictment revocation throughout the party convention, the push is highly likely," adding, "Minister Jung must have felt significant pressure in this situation." <<> Minister Jung's resignation is also expected to accelerate the cabinet reshuffle aimed at forming the second-term cabinet of the Lee Jae-myung administration. <<> ◇ If Indictments in Lee's Cases Are Revoked, It Must Go Through the Justice Minister... Jung Appears to Have Felt the Burden <<> Justice Minister Jung Sung-ho had repeatedly conveyed his intention to resign to President Lee Jae-myung, both directly and indirectly, but it was not accepted. At a cabinet meeting on the 4th, President Lee even told Minister Jung, "Hold on tight." Though the president urged him to stay, Jung formally submitted his resignation about two weeks later. A Ministry of Justice official said, "Minister Jung's health has reached a point where it is nearly impossible to carry out the duties of the minister, yet he held on," adding, "His decision to resign is firm." <<> Beyond health reasons, political circles have noted that the burden of revoking indictments in President Lee's cases and the recent passage of the abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers—pushed through by the ruling party—may have influenced his decision. While the Democratic Party is pushing for a special counsel to investigate whether the cases against President Lee were "fabricated indictments," and the Prosecution Future Committee has begun its review, there has been widespread prediction in legal circles that "if indictments are ultimately revoked, it will go through the hands of the justice minister." <<> Minister Jung is also known to have felt considerable disillusionment during the passage of the bill abolishing supplementary investigation powers (the Criminal Procedure Act amendment). Despite multiple attempts to persuade the ruling party to retain at least part of the supplementary investigation powers, once the bill passed according to the will of hardline Democrats, he reportedly told those around him, "They will have to bear the responsibility." In a Facebook post that day, Jung wrote, "Many citizens are concerned about the Criminal Procedure Act, which is set to take effect soon," adding, "Problems discovered after implementation should be addressed humbly and promptly, rather than treated with hostility as anti-reformist." On his way home from work, he also told reporters, "I will have more to do in the National Assembly to quickly fix the problems that emerged during party integration and the Criminal Procedure Act revision process." <<> A ruling camp figure said, "Minister Jung, as a long-time close associate of President Lee, has served as the 'patriarch' of the pro-Lee faction, but he is also a legal professional with 40 years of experience," adding, "I understand he felt deep disillusionment during the process of abolishing supplementary investigation powers." Another figure said, "It seems Jung judged that at this point, he could play a greater role as the 'patriarch' of the pro-Lee faction within the party rather than as justice minister." <<> The cabinet reshuffle for the second year of the Lee Jae-myung administration is also expected to speed up. President Lee hinted at a reshuffle during his first-anniversary press conference in June, saying, "There are a few areas where roles and approaches need to change," but it was delayed due to the party convention schedule. However, with the appointment of Han Sung-sook as Prime Minister leaving the Minister of SMEs and Startups position vacant for over a month, and Minister Jung's resignation, further delay has become difficult. Nevertheless, regarding the scale of the reshuffle, there were also remarks that day that "with the regular parliamentary session starting next month, it will be hard to replace ministers en masse ahead of the audit." (정성호 법무부 장관이 18일 청와대에 사직서를 제출했다. 청와대는 “후속 인사가 이뤄질 때까지 맡은 바 역할을 다해줄 것을 당부했다”며 사의 수용 뜻을 밝혔다. 정 장관은 그동안 건강상 이유 등으로 수차례 사의를 표했다. 이날 사직서에도 건강 문제와 함께 “검찰 개혁 관련 주요 입법이 마무리됐다”는 취지의 이유를 밝힌 것으로 전해졌다. 검찰청 폐지와 공소청·중대범죄수사청 신설, 검사의 보완 수사권 폐지 등 관련 법안 처리가 마무리돼 물러나겠다는 것이다.)

item.title: On Trump's Orders, Ongoing South Korea-US Exercises Also Cancelled (트럼프 지시에, 진행 중인 한미훈련도 취소)
item.description:
On Trump's Orders, Ongoing South Korea-US Exercises Also Cancelled (트럼프 지시에, 진행 중인 한미훈련도 취소)

As US President Donald Trump ordered a significant reduction in South Korea-US joint exercises, US Forces Korea (USFK) decided to cut the duration of the 'Ulchi Freedom Shield' (UFS) exercises, which began on the 17th, in half and skip the 'counteroffensive operations' in the latter phase. It is also reported that most of the 14 South Korea-US combined field training exercises will be cancelled. USFK reportedly notified the South Korean military and did not participate in training scheduled for the 18th. (도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 한미 연합훈련을 대폭 축소하라고 지시하면서 주한미군이 17일 시작된 ‘을지 자유의 방패’(UFS) 기간을 절반으로 줄이고 훈련 후반 ‘반격 작전’은 하지 않기로 했다. 또 한미 연합 야외기동훈련 14건 대부분을 취소할 것으로 알려졌다. 주한미군은 18일 예정됐던 훈련도 한국군에 통보하고 불참했다고 한다.)

USFK Commander General Xavier Brunson is known to have visited the Ministry of National Defense in Yongsan, Seoul, on the afternoon of the 18th to convey his views on changing the exercise plans to Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek. Additional US forces had already arrived in South Korea from the United States for these combined exercises, but they are expected to either participate in US-only training or some will return to the US. (제이비어 브런슨 주한미군 사령관은 18일 오후 서울 용산 국방부를 방문해 안규백 국방장관에게 훈련 계획 변경 의견을 전달한 것으로 알려졌다. 이번 연합훈련을 위해 주한미군 이외에 미국에서도 증원 병력이 한국에 도착한 상태인데, 이들은 미군 단독훈련에 참여하거나 일부는 귀국할 전망이다.)

In a post on Truth Social on the 16th (local time), President Trump stated, "Given that I have a very good relationship with North Korea's Kim Jong-un, I do not like the fact that the US agreed long ago to participate in combined military exercises with South Korea," and announced he had directed the US Secretary of Defense to significantly reduce the exercises. When Trump's remarks were reported on the first day of the UFS exercise, a Defense Ministry official said, "UFS is proceeding as scheduled." However, the US side has since notified of its intent to halt parts of the exercise. A military source described this as an unprecedented situation, saying, "Having the regular South Korea-US combined exercise schedule cut in half, and having field training exercises cancelled after they've already begun, is like a natural disaster." (트럼프 미 대통령은 지난 16일(현지 시각) 트루스소셜에 올린 글에서 “북한의 김정은과 내가 매우 좋은 관계를 맺고 있다는 점에 비춰볼 때 미국이 오래전에 한국과 연합 군사훈련에 참가하기로 합의했다는 사실이 마음에 들지 않는다”며 미 국방장관에게 훈련을 상당히 축소할 것을 지시했다고 밝혔다. UFS 훈련 첫날 트럼프 대통령 발언이 보도되자 국방부 관계자는 “UFS는 예정대로 진행 중”이라고 했다. 하지만 미측이 훈련 중단 입장을 통보한 것이다. 군 소식통은 “정례 한미 연합훈련 일정이 반토막 난 것도, 이미 시작된 가운데 야외기동훈련이 취소되는 것도 천재지변 같은 초유의 일”이라고 했다.)

Security experts expressed concerns that reducing the scale of South Korea-US combined exercises would weaken preparedness against North Korea's nuclear and conventional threats. They also noted that if there was no prior coordination between Seoul and Washington, it could be seen as a serious red flag for the alliance relationship. (안보 전문가들은 한미 연합훈련 규모가 축소될 경우 북한의 핵과 재래식 위협에 대한 대비 태세가 악화될 것이라고 우려했다. 한미 간 사전 조율이 없었다면 양국 동맹 관계에 심각한 적신호로 볼 수 있다고도 했다.)

At a Cabinet meeting held at the Blue House on this day, timed with the UFS exercise, President Lee Jae-myung addressed the wartime operational control (OPCON) authority currently held by the South Korea-US Combined Forces Command (and USFK Commander), stating, "We must proceed without disruption according to the original government plan for its return within my term." He also said, "I ask that you accelerate the push for a nuclear submarine, which will symbolize the future of a more constructive and robust South Korea-US alliance." (이재명 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 UFS 연습에 맞춰 개최된 국무회의에서 현재 한미연합사령관(주한미군 사령관)이 가진 전시작전통제권과 관련해 “임기 내 환수를 당초 정부의 계획에 따라 차질 없이 추진해 나가야 한다”고 했다. 또 “보다 건설적이고 굳건한 한미동맹의 미래를 상징할 핵잠수함 추진에 속도를 내주기 바란다”고 했다.)

◇ Ulchi exercise duration halved… no counteroffensive drills against North Korea at all (◇을지 연합훈련 기간 절반 축소… 대북 반격훈련은 아예 안 한다)

USFK Commander General Xavier Brunson was scheduled to attend and deliver a eulogy at the 50th anniversary commemoration of the Panmunjom axe murder incident held on the morning of the 18th at Camp Bonifas in Paju, Gyeonggi Province. However, he is known to have cancelled his attendance right before the event to enter discussions on adjusting the South Korea-US combined exercises. Brunson met with Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek at the Ministry of National Defense in Yongsan, Seoul, that afternoon to discuss the direction of reducing the exercises. (제이비어 브런슨 주한미군 사령관은 18일 오전 경기 파주 ‘캠프 보니파스’에서 열린 판문점 도끼만행 사건 50주기 추모식에 참석해 추도사를 할 예정이었다. 하지만 행사 직전 참석을 취소하고 한미 연합훈련 조정을 위한 논의에 들어간 것으로 알려졌다. 브런슨 사령관은 이날 오후 서울 용산 국방부에서 안규백 국방장관과 만나 훈련 축소 방향을 논의했다.)

This year's 'Ulchi Freedom Shield' (UFS) exercise was originally scheduled to run from the 17th to the 27th. The computer-simulated command post exercise (CPX) was divided into Part 1 (17th-21st), focused on defending against a North Korean invasion, and Part 2 (24th-27th), focused on counteroffensive operations. Brunson reportedly conveyed his position to conduct only Part 1. After his meeting with Minister Ahn, Brunson reportedly attended a meeting of South Korea-US exercise officials and said, "Let's finish what we can do well during Part 1," adding, "We have no choice but to shorten the scale, scope, and duration of the exercise." (올해 ‘을지 자유의 방패’(UFS) 훈련은 17~27일 실시할 예정이었다. 컴퓨터 시뮬레이션 기반인 지휘소연습(CPX)의 경우, 북한군 남침을 방어하는 1부(17~21일)와 반격하는 2부(24~27일)로 나뉘는데, 브런슨 사령관은 이 중 1부만 실시하겠다는 입장을 밝혔다고 한다. 브런슨 사령관은 안 장관과 면담 후 한미 훈련 관계자 회의에 참석해 “(지휘소연습) 1부 기간 우리가 할 수 있는 것들을 잘 마무리하자”며 “훈련 규모·범위와 기간을 단축할 수밖에 없다”고 말한 것으로 전해졌다.)

The Defense Ministry reportedly entered emergency response meetings following the US notification. The allied military authorities had announced this year's UFS plan, including 14 field training exercises, on the 10th, and began the exercise on the 17th. Even on the 17th, after President Trump posted his directive to reduce the exercises on social media, a Defense Ministry official stated, "UFS is proceeding as scheduled." (국방부는 미측의 통보에 긴급 대책회의에 들어간 것으로 전해졌다. 한미 군 당국은 지난 10일 14건의 야외기동훈련이 포함된 올해 UFS 계획을 발표했고, 17일 훈련을 시작했다. 국방부 관계자는 트럼프 대통령이 한미 연합훈련 축소 방침을 소셜미디어에 올린 후인 지난 17일에도 ”UFS는 예정대로 진행 중“이라고 했다.)

The Defense Ministry and Joint Chiefs of Staff have not issued statements regarding the exercise changes. A military official said, "Please refer to yesterday's Blue House statement for the official position." The Blue House stated on the 17th, "We have been closely coordinating with the US regarding combined exercises and training, and we will cooperate to ensure there are no issues with readiness." It was not confirmed whether the US side had given prior notice to South Korea about the possibility of exercise changes before the meetings on the 18th. (훈련 변경에 대해 국방부와 합동참모본부는 입장을 내지 않았다. 군 관계자는 “공식 입장은 어제 청와대 입장을 참조해 달라”고 했다. 청와대는 지난 17일 ”연합연습 및 훈련에 대해 미국과 긴밀히 조율해 왔고, 대비태세에 문제가 없도록 공조하겠다”고 했다. 18일 국방부와 주한미군 간 회의 전에 미국 측이 한국에 훈련 변경 가능성에 대해 사전 통보했는지는 확인되지 않았다.)

USFK is known to have deployed personnel to 'CP (Command Post) Tango' in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province – the allied wartime command post – on the 16th, but after President Trump ordered the reduction of the combined exercises, some personnel were withdrawn from CP Tango to Camp Humphreys in Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi Province, about 50 km to the south. This is seen as an effort to emphasize that the exercise was not simulating a wartime scenario against North Korea. (주한미군은 지난 16일 한미 전시(戰時) 지휘소인 경기 성남 ‘CP(Command Post) 탱고’에 인원을 배치했다가 트럼프 미 대통령이 연합훈련 축소를 지시하자 일부 인력을 CP 탱고에서 남쪽으로 50㎞ 떨어진 경기 평택 험프리스 미군기지로 철수시킨 것으로 알려졌다. 북한과의 전시를 상정한 훈련이 아니라는 점을 강조한 것이라는 관측이다.)

During the first Trump administration (2017-2021), South Korea and the US did postpone or cancel combined exercises during the US-North Korea dialogue phase. However, it is unprecedented for a combined exercise agreed upon by both countries months in advance to be shortened and reduced after the exercise has already begun. USFK has always placed great importance on the combined exercises, and during the 'Freedom Shield' (FS) exercise in the first half of this year, when the South Korean side sought to cancel field training exercises, the US insisted on maintaining the existing agreements, and the exercise proceeded as planned. A retired general said, "Given that this government has been burdened by the combined exercises to send a conciliatory message to North Korea, it seems they are quietly welcoming the US move to reduce them." (트럼프 1기 행정부(2017~2021년) 때도 미북 대화 국면에서 한미가 연합훈련을 연기하거나 취소한 적은 있다. 하지만 수개월 전부터 양국이 협의해 결정한 한미 연합훈련이 훈련 개시 후 단축 및 축소된 것은 초유의 일이다. 주한미군은 한미 연합훈련을 중시해왔고, 올 상반기 ‘자유의 방패’(FS) 훈련 때는 한국 측이 야외기동훈련을 취소하려 했지만 기존 합의를 지키라는 미국 측 입장이 강경해 계획대로 훈련이 실시되기도 했다. 예비역 장성은 “대북 유화 메시지를 위해 한미 연합연습을 부담스러워했던 현 정부 입장에서는 내심 미국의 훈련 축소 움직임을 반기고 있는 것으로 보인다”고 했다.)

In diplomatic circles, the reduction of the South Korea-US combined exercises is analyzed as part of President Trump's coercive diplomacy. The move is seen as using the exercise reduction as leverage to bring Kim Jong-un to the negotiating table, while simultaneously signaling dissatisfaction with South Korea over delayed US investments and a lukewarm response to requests for support in the Iran war. Kim Jae-cheon, a professor at Sogang University, said, "Considerable frustration has accumulated toward South Korea over the delay in $350 billion in US investments," adding, "This appears to include pressure to speed up investment execution by holding security as a hostage." US media outlet Politico, citing an anonymous official, reported that "Trump's threats stem from the broader economic frustrations of the US administration toward the South Korean government." (외교가에선 한미 연합훈련 축소를 트럼프 미 대통령의 압박 외교의 일환이라고 분석했다. 훈련 축소를 지렛대 삼아 김정은을 협상 테이블로 끌어내는 동시에, 한국에는 대미 투자 지연과 이란 전쟁 지원 요구에 대한 미온적 대응에 불만을 드러냈다는 것이다. 김재천 서강대 교수는 “3500억달러 대미 투자 지연으로 한국에 대한 불만이 상당히 누적된 상태”라며 “안보를 볼모로 투자 집행에 속도를 내라는 압박 성격도 있어 보인다”고 했다. 미국 언론 폴리티코는 익명의 관계자를 인용해 “트럼프 대통령의 위협은 한국 정부에 대한 미 행정부 전반의 경제적 불만에서 비롯된 것”이라고 했다.)

Within the military, there are concerns that, with President Trump having announced the reduction directive, other planned exercises for the second half of the year – such as the South Korea-US Combined Nuclear & Conventional (CNI) table-top exercise 'Iron Mace,' the combined air exercise 'Freedom Flag,' and the large-scale amphibious landing exercise 'Ssangyong' involving South Korean and US Marines – could also be cancelled or reduced one after another. Field training exercises, which include airborne, amphibious, and special operations forces missions, serve to validate and refine wartime operational plans against North Korea. A military official said, "The cancellation of field training exercises inevitably leads to a weakening of readiness," adding, "There is much that South Korea learns from training with US forces, from the exercise systems to post-exercise validation procedures, and that opportunity is now disappearing." (군에선 트럼프 대통령이 훈련 축소 방침을 밝힌 만큼 하반기 계획된 한미 핵·재래식 통합(CNI) 도상훈련인 ‘아이언메이스’, 한미 공중연합훈련 ‘프리덤 플래그’, 대규모 상륙작전이 핵심인 한·미 해병대의 ‘쌍룡훈련’ 등도 줄줄이 취소, 축소될 수 있다는 우려가 나온다. 도하·상륙작전·특수부대 작전 등이 포함되는 야외기동훈련은 유사시 대북 작전계획을 검증하고 보완하는 기능을 한다. 군 관계자는 “야외기동훈련 취소는 대비태세 약화로 이어질 수밖에 없다”며 “미군과 훈련하면서 훈련 시스템부터 사후 검증 절차까지 한국이 배우는 것이 많은데 그런 기회가 사라지는 것”이라고 했다.)

The reduction of the South Korea-US combined exercises could also negatively impact the government's push for an early transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON). The government aims to complete the Full Operational Capability (FOC) validation for the future Combined Forces Command at this year's Security Consultative Meeting (SCM) and present a target year for the OPCON transition. Some evaluations and validations related to meeting OPCON transition conditions are conducted through combined exercises, and a reduction could cause setbacks. However, some argue that since the FOC evaluation was already completed during the 2022 exercise, the direct impact may not be significant. (한미 연합훈련 축소는 정부가 추진하는 전시작전통제권(전작권) 조기 환수에도 악영향을 줄 수 있다. 정부는 올해 한미안보협의회의(SCM)에서 미래연합사 완전운용능력(FOC) 검증을 마치고 전작권 전환 목표 연도를 제시하는 것을 목표로 하고 있다. 연합훈련을 통해 전작권 전환 조건 충족과 관련한 평가·검증이 일부 이뤄지는데 훈련이 축소될 경우 차질이 생길 수 있다. 다만 FOC 평가는 2022년 훈련에서 이뤄진 만큼 직접적인 영향은 크지 않다는 의견도 있다.)

item.title: Aircraft carriers leave, allied drills shrink… "'Pivot to Asia' is dead" (항공모함 떠나고, 연합 훈련 축소하고… “‘피벗 투 아시아’는 죽었다”)
item.description:
Aircraft carriers leave, allied drills shrink… "'Pivot to Asia' is dead" (항공모함 떠나고, 연합 훈련 축소하고… “‘피벗 투 아시아’는 죽었다”)

As the U.S. military operation against Iran drags on, U.S. Navy aircraft carriers deployed to the Pacific have moved to the Middle East, and President Donald Trump has even ordered a major reduction in U.S.-South Korea joint exercises, raising concerns in U.S. political and policy circles about a security vacuum in the Indo-Pacific. Since the Obama administration, the United States has pursued a foreign policy of shifting its strategic center to Asia and projecting resources to counter China, but under Trump's second term, which is particularly averse to intervention in foreign affairs, trust among Indo-Pacific allies in U.S. security commitments appears to be eroding. Richard Haass, president emeritus of the Council on Foreign Relations (CFR), said on the 18th, "The United States has long pursued a 'pivot to Asia,' but with a president who chooses authoritarian adversaries over allies, we are witnessing a turn away from Asia." <<> The "Pivot to Asia," also called the "Asia rebalancing," was a U.S. strategy emphasizing the Asia-Pacific region that the Barack Obama administration began in earnest in the early 2010s. The core idea was to move away from over-concentrating diplomatic and security resources in the Middle East, including Iraq and Afghanistan, and shift the center of gravity to Asia, which would become the center of 21st-century politics and economics. The first Trump administration largely carried on this trajectory through the concept of a "Free and Open Indo-Pacific" (FOIP), while far more explicitly emphasizing strategic competition with China, which had begun to emerge as a full-fledged U.S. rival during that period. A key figure in that effort was the late former Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe. The subsequent Biden administration also kept the FOIP framework intact and institutionalized it, focusing on containing China through minilateral cooperation with allies and partner nations. <<> In this context, the U.S. withdrawal of significant numbers of aircraft carriers, air-defense assets, and troops, along with the reduction of military exercises, is heightening a sense of crisis among allies underpinning the Indo-Pacific strategy. The U.S. Navy's George Washington Carrier Strike Group (CSG), which had been deployed in the Pacific, departed the Singapore Strait on the 13th to head to the Middle East for a handover with the USS Abraham Lincoln, making a "Pacific without U.S. carriers" a reality. In August 2024, heightened Middle East tensions had also forced the U.S. to refrain for a time from operating a carrier in the Pacific in an offensive posture, and each time this happened, China probed U.S. deterrence in the South China Sea and the Taiwan Strait while seeking to expand its influence. Axios noted that China's argument that "U.S. security commitments are not reliable" could be reinforced. Haass said, "China and North Korea will exploit this situation, and our friends will either despair or choose nuclear weapons." <<> In an editorial, the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) cited Trump's order to reduce U.S.-South Korea exercises and his criticism of South Korea over its "non-participation" in denuclearization efforts toward Iran, stating it "will further reinforce perceptions in Asia and Europe that America is becoming an unreliable ally." The paper also noted that domestic calls in South Korea for its own nuclear armament could grow, and pointed out that even if that was not Trump's intent, the world is questioning U.S. "capacity." However, former Deputy Secretary of State Kurt Campbell, in an article published on the 18th in the foreign affairs and security journal Foreign Affairs, acknowledged that Trump has dealt a serious blow to alliances but said a full "collapse of alliances" is unlikely, adding, "Threat perceptions in Europe and Asia that China and Russia constitute one interconnected strategic challenge are converging to unprecedented degrees, and even if allies try to de-risk from the United States, there are many areas where dependence on Washington is actually increasing." <<> Criticism continued in U.S. political circles, led mainly by Democrats. Rep. Ami Bera, ranking member of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, said, "At a time when trust in U.S. security commitments is already being tested, weakening our deterrence posture to accommodate a communist dictator is not only a betrayal of democratic allies but further undermines U.S. credibility across the Indo-Pacific." Sen. Andy Kim, of Korean descent, revealed that he met with South Korean Ambassador to the U.S. Cho Hyun-dong that day, saying, "The U.S.-ROK strategic partnership and security alliance has served for decades as a linchpin of peace, security, and prosperity in the Indo-Pacific region," and added, "Backed by strong bipartisan support in Congress, we must do everything we can to continue deepening this invaluable relationship." (미국의 대(對)이란 군사 작전 장기화 속 태평양에 배치됐던 미 해군 항공모함이 중동으로 이동하고, 도널드 트럼프 대통령이 한미 연합 훈련 ‘대폭 축소’까지 지시하면서 인도·태평양의 안보 공백을 우려하는 목소리가 미 조야(朝野)에서 나오고 있다. 미국은 오바마 정부 때부터 전략적 중심을 아시아로 이동하고 중국 견제에 자원을 투사하는 대외 정책을 펼쳐왔지만, 대외 문제 개입에 특히 부정적인 트럼프 2기 들어 미국의 안보 공약에 대한 인·태 동맹의 신뢰가 약화하는 모습이다. 리처드 하스 미국외교협회(CFR) 명예회장은 18일 “미국은 오랜 기간 ‘피벗 투 아시아’를 추구해 왔지만 대통령이 동맹보다 전체주의 적을 선택하는 상황에서 아시아로부터의 전환을 보고 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee Seok-yeon, Presidential Committee Chairman for National Unity: "Lee Must Leave the Party to Become 'President for All'" (이석연 국민통합위원장 “李, ‘모두의 대통령’ 위해 탈당해야”)
item.description:
Lee Seok-yeon, chairman of the Presidential Committee for National Unity, stated to President Lee Jae-myung, "If you truly wish to become a 'president for all' who unites the people, you must leave the Democratic Party of Korea." (이석연 대통령 직속 국민통합위원장이 이재명 대통령을 향해 “국민을 통합하는 ‘모두의 대통령’이 되고자 한다면 더불어민주당을 탈당해야 한다”고 밝혔다.)

Chairman Lee appeared on MBC's "100-minute Debate" on the evening of the 18th and said, "I would like to publicly suggest one decision to the president" and "The party's national convention has just concluded. Now is the time to leave the Democratic Party." (이 위원장은 18일 밤 MBC ‘100분 토론’에 출연해 “대통령께 한 가지 결단을 공개적으로 건의하고 싶다”며 “마침 민주당 전당대회도 끝났다. 이제 민주당을 탈당하라”고 말했다.)

Chairman Lee said, "As chairman of the National Unity Committee, I am sharing words with the president that may be somewhat uncomfortable. If this is discourteous, I will take responsibility for it," adding, "I believe the president must feel the heaviest responsibility for the current disorder in state affairs and the severe division of public opinion." (이 위원장은 “국민통합위원장으로서 대통령께 조금은 불편할 수 있는 말씀을 드린다. 결례가 된다면 그 책임도 제가 지겠다”면서 “지금의 국정 난맥과 극심한 국론 분열 현상에 대해서는 대통령께서 가장 무거운 책임을 느끼셔야 한다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

He continued, "The Constitution does not require the president to leave the party," but added, "If you have declared national unity as the top priority of governance and truly wish to become a 'president for all,' I hope you will now step outside the political fence of being the president of a single party." (이어 “헌법이 대통령에게 탈당을 요구하는 것은 아니다”라면서도 “국민 통합을 국정의 제1의 목표로 내걸고 진정으로 ‘모두의 대통령’이 되고자 한다면, 이제는 한 정당의 대통령이라는 정치적 울타리에서 벗어나셨으면 한다”고 했다.)

Chairman Lee said, "You must embrace and bring along the people who did not support you, as well as those who opposed you," and "I am concerned that politics is once again dividing sides around the president." (이 위원장은 “대통령을 지지하지 않았던 국민들, 또 대통령에게 반대했던 국민들도 함께 포용하고 끌어안고 가셔야 한다”며 “지금은 다시 대통령을 중심으로 정치가 편을 가르는 것이 아닌가 하는 염려도 된다”고 했다.)

He added, "The ruling party is competing over who is closer to the president, while the opposition is taking an extreme stance of confrontation against the president and the government." (그는 그러면서 “여당은 대통령과 누가 더 가까운지를 경쟁하고 있고, 야당은 대통령과 정부를 향해 극단적인 반대 입장에서 각을 세우고 있다”고 했다.)

Chairman Lee said, "Leave the Democratic Party to its new leadership, and return not as the president of the Democratic Party, but as the president of the people. You must run state affairs from a nonpartisan standpoint—this is the right time." (이 위원장은 “민주당은 새 지도부에 맡기고, 대통령께서는 민주당의 대통령이 아니라 국민의 대통령으로 돌아오라”며 “초당적인 입장에서 국정을 운영하셔야 한다, 지금이 바로 적기”라고 했다.)

Meanwhile, the presidential office announced on the 19th that it would launch a YouTube live broadcast titled "We Need a Conversation for National Unity," inviting people from various classes, generations, and regions to share their voices. It will air biweekly starting at 2 p.m. that day via the KTV YouTube channel. (한편 청와대는 19일 다양한 계층과 세대, 지역의 국민들을 초대해 목소리를 듣는 유튜브 라이브 방송 ‘국민 통합 대화가 필요해’를 시작한다고 밝혔다. 이날 오후 2시부터 KTV 유튜브 채널을 통해 격주로 방송된다.)

The initiative aims to foster a mood of national unity by providing a platform for communication where people with different thoughts and positions can understand one another. The Office of the Presidential Secretary for National Unity stated, "We hope that such gatherings for sharing thoughts and experiences will serve as the first step toward mutual respect and the restoration of dialogue." (서로 다른 생각과 입장을 가진 사람들이 서로 이해할 수 있는 소통의 장을 마련해 국민 통합 분위기를 조성하려는 취지다. 청와대 국민통합비서관실은 “서로의 생각과 경험을 나누는 이 같은 자리가 서로를 존중하고 대화가 복원되는 첫 단추가 되기를 바란다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: US experts say “reducing military drills is a wise move… South Korea is playing a dangerous game” (美전문가들 “훈련 축소는 현명한 조치… 한국, 위험한 게임하고 있어”)
item.description:
US experts say “reducing military drills is a wise move… South Korea is playing a dangerous game” (美전문가들 “훈련 축소는 현명한 조치… 한국, 위험한 게임하고 있어”)

As President Donald Trump signaled his willingness to talk with Kim Jong-un and ordered a drastic reduction in South Korea-U.S. combined military exercises, Jennifer Kavanaugh, a senior fellow at the Washington, D.C.-based think tank Defense Priorities, argued that this is “a necessary and strategically wise measure that serves U.S. national interests” and that security responsibility should be handed over entirely to South Korea. Kavanaugh co-authored a report with Dan Caldwell, who served as senior advisor to Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth last year, calling for reducing the approximately 28,500 U.S. troops stationed in South Korea to about 10,000. Her stance reflects the MAGA (Make America Great Again) perspective that the U.S. should disengage from foreign affairs. <<> In a statement released on the 17th, Kavanaugh claimed that “U.S.-led military exercises in the western Pacific often escalate regional tensions by provoking and antagonizing Beijing (China) and Pyongyang (North Korea) rather than making the region more peaceful,” adding that they accelerated military buildup, including test launches of new weapons, instead of deterrence. She further argued that “as a result, the security environment deteriorates, increasing the risk of allies and U.S. forces being drawn into conflict,” and that this would be an untenable risk for the U.S., whose resources have been depleted by failed military operations against Iran. She added, “U.S. forces should not be prepared to fight alongside South Korea, especially not in a war on the Korean Peninsula against North Korea” and “security responsibility should be handed over entirely to Seoul.” <<> Kavanaugh said, “South Korea is fully capable of managing conventional defense and should prepare to do so soon,” adding, “Continuing to reassure Seoul that the U.S. will always be there through combined exercises and large-scale forward deployment does not support this goal. item.title: Presidential Economic Chief: "Yongsan Park Is Too Large, Causing Security Issues... Not Many People Either" (靑 경제수석 “용산공원, 너무 커서 치안문제...사람도 별로없어”)
item.description:
Ha Jun-kyung, the presidential chief of staff for economic growth, said regarding the government's plan to develop Yongsan Park in Seoul to supply large-scale housing, "Turning all of this vast land into a park is an enormous scale rarely seen anywhere in the world," adding, "There are many security issues and other factors that incur social costs, so we need to discuss what would be the best use for it." (하준경 청와대 경제성장수석은 서울 용산공원을 개발해 대규모 주택을 공급하겠다는 정부 방침과 관련해 “이 큰 땅을 다 공원으로 한다는 건 세계적으로 보기 힘든 어마어마한 규모”라며 “많은 치안 문제나 이런 게 있어서 사회적으로 비용을 발생시키는 부분이 있어서, 이걸 어떻게 쓰는 게 좋은 것이냐 논의해볼 필요가 있다”고 말했다.)

Ha made these remarks during an appearance on TV Chosun that day, noting that the size of Yongsan Park is larger than the area inside the embankment of Yeouido. (하 수석은 이날 TV조선에 출연해 용산공원 크기가 여의도 제방 안쪽 지역 넓이보다 더 크다며 이같이 말했다.)

Ha then stated, "A park only holds meaning when people actually use it extensively," and "If you visit Yongsan Children's Garden, there are hardly any people." He added, "Not many people use it, and compared to the Children's Grand Park, it's far smaller. I think it's important that this prime piece of land is utilized well." This suggests that Yongsan Children's Garden, which has been mentioned as a site for building rental housing complexes for the younger generation, could be considered for alternative uses due to its low visitor numbers. (하 수석은 그러면서 “공원이라는 것은 사람들이 기본적으로 많이 이용했을 때 의미가 있다”며 “용산어린이정원 가보면 사람들이 별로 없다”고 했다. 이어 “이용하는 사람이 많지 않고 어린이대공원과 비교해보면 훨씬 작다”며 “이 금싸라기 땅이 잘 이용되는 게 중요하다고 생각한다”고 했다. 청년 세대를 위한 임대주택 단지 조성 부지로 거론되는 용산어린이정원이 이용하는 사람이 많지 않아 다른 용도로 이용하는 방안을 검토할 수 있다는 것이다.)

Ha also addressed the contamination issues on the Yongsan Park site. Due to the site's unique history of being used by the Japanese military and later the U.S. military for over a century, contamination cleanup is required. Ha said, "Even if we wanted to create something like Central Park, there's the issue of having to remove contaminants," and "Removing the contaminants could cost anywhere from hundreds of billions of won to trillions of won." (하 수석은 용산공원 부지의 오염 문제도 언급했다. 용산공원 부지는 100년 넘게 일본군과 미군이 사용했던 특수성으로 인해 오염 정화 작업이 필요하다. 하 수석은 “센트럴파크 같은 것을 만들고 싶어도 오염 물질을 제거해야 하는 이슈가 있다”며 “오염 물질 제거에 적게는 수천억에서 (많게는) 조 단위로 들어간다”고 했다.)

Ha continued, "If we decide to make it a park, it would cost a tremendous amount of money, and it wouldn't be easy for any government to pour trillions of won into it," adding, "If we use the site for housing instead, we could dig up the land and transport the soil elsewhere for cleanup." This is interpreted as meaning that if there's a justification like housing supply, funds could be invested in cleanup, but spending that much money simply to create a park would be difficult. (하 수석은 그러면서 “거기를 공원으로 만들겠다면 엄청난 돈이 드는데, 어느 정부도 조 단위 돈을 거기 투입하기는 쉽지 않을 것”이라며 “만약 여기를 주택으로 쓴다면 그 땅을 파고 흙을 다른 데로 반출해서 정화 작업을 할 수 있다”고 했다. 주택 공급 같은 명분이 있다면 정화 작업에 돈을 들일 수 있지만, 단순히 공원 조성 정도에는 그 정도 돈을 쓰기 어렵다는 의미로 해석된다.)

To build housing on Yongsan Park, the Special Act on the Creation of Yongsan Park, enacted in 2007 under the Roh Moo-hyun administration, would need to be amended. The ruling party has expressed its intention to revise the law, while the opposition has called it a "self-contradiction by the Democratic Party government." (용산공원에 주택을 지으려면 지난 2007년 노무현 정부 때 제정된 용산공원조성특별법을 고쳐야 한다. 여당은 이 법을 고치겠다는 입장이고, 야당에서는 “민주당 정부의 자기모순”이라고 하고 있다.)

Regarding the legal amendment, Ha said, "We could consider adding a provision that would enable development." He stated, "Seoul's housing situation 20 years ago and now are vastly different, and housing prices then and now differ enormously. If there's a significant public interest purpose, we could exclude certain portions through deliberation." (하 수석은 법 개정에 대해 “(개발을 가능하게 하는) 조항을 하나 넣는 것을 생각해볼 수 있을 것 같다”고 했다. 그는 “20년 전 서울 주거 상황과 지금 상황은 많이 바뀌었고, 그 당시 집값과 지금은 엄청난 차이가 있다”며 “어떤 중대한 공익적 목적이 있을 경우 심의를 통해 일부를 제척할 수 있다”고 했다.)

The government is pushing forward with development of the Yongsan Park area in Seoul to address the housing supply problem. In this regard, it is considering plans to create a large-scale rental housing complex for the younger generation at Yongsan Children's Garden in Seoul. Although the Seoul Metropolitan Government, Yongsan District Office, and local residents oppose the plan, it has been reported that the government intends to overcome the opposition through a public deliberation process. (정부는 주택 공급 문제를 해결하기 위해 서울 용산공원 일대 개발을 추진 중이다. 이와 관련, 서울 용산어린이정원에 청년 세대를 위한 대규모 임대주택 단지를 조성하는 방안을 검토하고 있다. 서울시와 용산구, 지역 주민이 반대하고 있지만 공론화 과정을 통해 반대 여론을 누르겠다는 방침인 것으로 전해졌다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok Appoints Four-Term Lawmaker Han Jeong-ae as Party Secretary-General, Kwon Chil-seung as Policy Committee Chairman (김민석, 당 사무총장에 4선 한정애… 정책위의장엔 권칠승 임명)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok Appoints Four-Term Lawmaker Han Jeong-ae as Party Secretary-General, Kwon Chil-seung as Policy Committee Chairman (김민석, 당 사무총장에 4선 한정애… 정책위의장엔 권칠승 임명)

On his first day in office, the 18th, Democratic Party leader Kim Min-seok appointed four-term lawmaker Han Jeong-ae as Secretary-General, overseeing the party's organization, personnel, and finances. The new Secretary-General, who served as Environment Minister in the Moon Jae-in government, was previously picked as Policy Committee Chairman under the Chung Cheong-rae leadership, but she is not referred to as a close associate of the pro-Chung faction. For Policy Committee Chairman, Kim selected three-term lawmaker Kwon Chil-seung, who served as senior spokesperson during President Lee Jae-myung's tenure as party leader. Kim Nam-jun, a close aide of President Lee, was appointed as Communications Committee Chairman, and Shin Jung-hoon as Chairman of the Good Local Government Committee. This follows the appointments the previous day of key pro-Lee figures Kim Tae-seon and Park Seong-jun as Chief of Staff and Senior Spokesperson, respectively. A party official said, "Rather than a balancing act by embracing pro-Chung figures, Kim appears to have chosen stable party management." <<> Kim also attended the 17th anniversary memorial ceremony for former President Kim Dae-jung and paid respects at the National 5·18 Democratic Cemetery in Gwangju that day. Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, had initially planned to attend the memorial ceremony but canceled his schedule, so the first meeting between the ruling and opposition party leaders fell through. In his memorial address, Kim said, "As the late President's youngest chief of staff, I greet you after becoming the Democratic Party leader following in his footsteps." He was also seen shedding tears during the ceremony. On the 19th, Kim is scheduled to hold an on-site Supreme Council meeting in Busan, then visit the grave of former President Roh Moo-hyun at Bongha Village in Gimhae, South Gyeongsang Province, and pay a call on former President Moon Jae-in at Pyeongsan Village in Yangsan. <<> Kim will also attend the first high-level ruling party-government consultation meeting on the 23rd after taking office. Although it is primarily a introductory meeting, discussions may cover supplementary measures for real estate tax reform and housing supply policies. During his candidacy on the 14th, Kim said, "While broadly agreeing with the direction of the real estate tax reform plan, we need to discuss supplementary details," raising the need to address concerns over side effects such as the comprehensive real estate tax on non-resident single-home owners. Key figures including Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hun-sik and Prime Minister Han Seong-suk are expected to attend the meeting. Kim's participation in the high-level consultation marks his first in about four months since April 22, before the prime minister's resignation, and his first as party leader. (더불어민주당 김민석 대표는 취임 첫날인 18일 당의 조직, 인사, 재정을 총괄하는 사무총장에 4선 한정애 의원을 임명했다. 문재인 정부 환경부 장관을 지낸 한 신임 사무총장은 정청래 지도부에서 정책위의장에 발탁됐지만 친정청래계로 불리진 않는다. 정책위의장에는 이재명 대통령의 당대표 시절 수석대변인을 지낸 3선 권칠승 의원을 발탁했다. 홍보위원장에는 이 대통령의 최측근 김남준 의원을, 참좋은지방정부위원장에는 신정훈 의원을 임명했다. 전날 비서실장과 수석대변인에 각각 친명 핵심 김태선, 박성준 의원을 임명한 데 이은 당직 인선이다. 민주당 관계자는 “김 대표가 친청계 등을 안는 탕평책이 아닌 안정적 당 운영을 선택한 것으로 보인다”고 했다.)

item.title: "Wall-Free One Team" "Concept of One Team Must Change"... Pro-Myung vs. Pro-Chung Conflict Persists After Party Convention (“벽 없는 원팀” “원팀 개념 바꿔야”… 전대 끝나도 명청갈등)
item.description:
"Wall-Free One Team" "Concept of One Team Must Change"... Pro-Myung vs. Pro-Chung Conflict Persists After Party Convention (“벽 없는 원팀” “원팀 개념 바꿔야”… 전대 끝나도 명청갈등 )

On the 18th, his first day in office, new Democratic Party of Korea leader Kim Min-seok emphasized being a "one team without walls," but on the same day, pro-Chung Supreme Council member Choi Min-hee, newly appointed as senior supreme council member, said "the concept of one team must change." While Kim took control of the party at the August 17 party convention, three of the five elected supreme council members—Choi Min-hee, Lee Seong-yun, and Han Min-soo—are from the pro-Chung (pro-Chung Cheong-rae) faction. With subtle tensions continuing between both sides immediately after the convention, speculation is rising that the new leadership may strike discordant notes over party management and policy direction. <<> That day, Kim met with presidential chief of staff Kang Hun-sik, who brought a congratulatory flower basket from President Lee Jae-myung, and senior presidential secretary for political affairs Hong Ik-pyo at the National Assembly, saying, "I have a sense, expectation, and sense of responsibility that completion and communication as a one team without walls will be achieved." Pro-Myung Supreme Council member Park Seon-won also emphasized unity after the convention on Facebook that day, saying, "Let us now become one to firmly support the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration." <<> However, Supreme Council member Choi, in a radio appearance that day, took aim at Kim's remarks, saying, "Does 'one team' mean no diverse voices, no slightly different opinions, no disagreements?" adding, "The concept of one team must change." Regarding the convention results, she said party members had sent a message for Kim to actively support President Lee, but added, "Still, shouldn't the party reform itself?" On internal disagreements over the government's real estate tax reform plan, she asked, "Are we going to brand all those people as anti-Myung?" and said, "In a democratic party, disagreement is natural." While Kim argues for the need to adjust the tax reform plan, Choi maintains the position that it should be passed as originally proposed. <<> Former leader Chung Cheong-rae also turned on a YouTube livestream the previous evening immediately after his defeat and unloaded pointed remarks. Chung said, "For a year as party leader, I couldn't say what I wanted to and held back—I'm not even a monk, but I was about to produce relics (from meditation)." He did not explain why he couldn't speak, but observers speculate his remarks referenced the recurring friction between the party and the administration over various issues. He said, "The pain of not being able to speak as party leader was too great. Being in a prison of words was truly hard," adding, "I'll live saying what I want to say. What is life anyway?" Targeting Kim, who throughout the convention had branded him as 'anti-Myung,' he said, "He won, but his argument lost." <<> Although the Democratic Party's new leadership has been elected, many within the party say "the pro-Myung and pro-Chung conflict is not easily subsiding, raising concerns about discord within the leadership." The fact that the convention results did not tilt one-sidedly toward the pro-Myung faction, including Kim, is also cited as a backdrop for the pro-Chung faction raising its voice. <<> Kim failed to secure a majority in the combined first-round vote and only secured victory in the second tally, which applied the 'preferential voting system' introduced for the first time in this convention's leadership race. Without the preferential voting system, he would have faced a runoff against Chung, prolonging the tight contest. Indeed, in votes by party members with voting rights in most regions except Honam, the gap between the two candidates was only around 1 percentage point, and in the public opinion survey, Chung actually led with 50.70% over Kim's 49.30%. <<> A similar trend was detected in the supreme council election, which selected five members. All three pro-Chung candidates who ran were elected, defeating the pro-Myung faction's two winners. Notably, pro-Chung candidates took first through third place in the public opinion survey. Kim Yong, a supreme council candidate and one of President Lee's closest aides, was ultimately defeated—despite a last-minute push from pro-Myung candidates Im Mi-ae and Kim Young-ho withdrawing to consolidate votes, he ranked last in the survey and failed to clear the bar of public sentiment. A key ruling camp official said, "Couldn't the party sentiment and public sentiment across all regions except Honam be signaling that checks on the Lee Jae-myung administration are needed?" Pro-government YouTuber Kim Eo-jun also said on YouTube on the 18th, regarding the pro-Myung candidate's defeat, "Democratic Party lawmakers will now start weighing whether the 'pro-Myung' label helps their politics or their elections." A senior Democratic Party figure said, "Chung also read this mood and isn't cowed by the convention defeat." <<> Within the party, voices have also emerged urging restraint on the pro-Chung faction. Lawmaker Park Ji-won, in a radio appearance that day, responded to Chung's remark that "Kim won, but his argument lost," saying, "Adding that kind of barb was not desirable for Chung's political future either," and added, "Cleanly conceding is greater democracy." (더불어민주당 김민석 신임 대표가 18일 취임 첫날 “벽이 없는 원팀”을 강조했지만, 친청계 최민희 신임 수석최고위원은 같은 날 “원팀의 개념은 바뀌어야 한다”고 했다. 8·17 전당대회에서 당권은 김 대표가 잡았지만 선출직 최고위원 5명 중 최민희·이성윤·한민수 의원 등 친청(친정청래)계 3명이 입성했다. 전대가 끝나자마자 양측의 미묘한 신경전이 이어지면서 새 지도부가 당 운영과 정책 노선을 놓고 불협화음을 내는 것 아니냐는 말이 나온다.)

item.title: Lee Appoints Lee Tae-han as Special Prosecutor for National Election Commission (선관위 특검에 李, 이태한 임명)
item.description:
Lee Appoints Lee Tae-han as Special Prosecutor for National Election Commission (선관위 특검에 李, 이태한 임명)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 18th appointed attorney Lee Tae-han (60, Judicial Research and Training Institute class 23), a former prosecutor recommended by the Korean Bar Association, as the "special prosecutor for the National Election Commission" to investigate incidents such as the ballot shortage during the June 3 local elections. The special prosecutor will launch investigations into various allegations surrounding the National Election Commission, including poor ballot management, manipulation of voting statistics, unfair hiring and promotion privileges, luxury overseas trips, and bid irregularities related to advance voting ballot boxes. (이재명 대통령은 18일 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등을 수사하기 위한 ‘선거관리위원회 특별검사’에 변협이 추천한 검사 출신 이태한(60·사법연수원 23기) 변호사를 임명했다. 특검은 투표관리 부실, 투표 통계 조작, 부정 채용과 승진 특혜, 외유성 해외출장, 사전투표함 입찰 비리 등 선관위를 둘러싼 각종 의혹에 대한 수사에 나서게 된다.)

Kang Yu-jung, senior press secretary at the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae, announced that day that President Lee had appointed Lee as the special prosecutor for the National Election Commission. Born in Busan, Special Prosecutor Lee, a graduate of the Judicial Research and Training Institute class 23, began his career as a prosecutor at the Daegu District Prosecutors' Office and served as chief prosecutor of the special investigations division at the Ulsan District Prosecutors' Office and chief prosecutor at the Seongnam branch of the Suwon District Prosecutors' Office. He left the prosecution in 2013 after serving as chief prosecutor of the Criminal Division 4 at the Seoul Southern District Prosecutors' Office, and subsequently worked as an attorney, serving as a director of the Korean Bar Association's Human Rights Foundation, advisory counsel to the Korea Land and Housing Corporation, and a member of the Ministry of Justice's Prosecutorial Personnel Committee. Since May of last year, he has been serving as a non-standing commissioner of the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission. (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 이 대통령이 이 변호사를 선관위 특검으로 임명했다고 밝혔다. 부산 출신인 이 특검은 사법연수원 23기로 대구지검 검사로 입직해 울산지검 특수부 부장검사, 수원지검 성남지청 부장검사 등을 지냈다. 2013년 서울남부지검 형사4부 부장검사를 끝으로 검찰을 떠났고, 이후 변호사로 활동하며 대한변호사협회 인권재단 이사, 한국토지주택공사 고문변호사, 법무부 검찰인사위원회 위원 등을 지냈다. 지난해 5월부턴 국민권익위원회 비상임위원으로 재임 중이다.)

Special Prosecutor Lee met with reporters at his office in Seocho-gu, Seoul, that day and said, "The special investigation team to be formed will not conduct its investigation with any predetermined conclusions unfavorable to either the ruling party or the opposition party," adding, "The most important duty is to uncover the substantive truth based on facts without political bias." He further stated, "We will not merely stop at exposing past wrongdoings but will closely examine what structural and institutional problems existed in the electoral process," and added, "With a profound sense of mission to protect the people's right to vote, I will operate the special investigation team according to the law without the slightest wavering and without yielding to any external pressure." (이 특검은 이날 서울 서초구 사무실에서 기자들과 만나 “앞으로 구성될 특검팀은 여당이나 야당 어느 쪽에도 불리한 결론을 미리 정해놓고 수사하지 않겠다”며 “가장 중요한 책무는 정치적 선입견 없이 사실관계에 따라 실체적 진실을 규명하는 것”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “단순히 과거의 잘못을 밝혀내는 데 그치지 않고 선거 관리 과정에서 어떤 구조적, 제도적 문제가 있었는지 면밀히 살펴보겠다”며 “국민의 참정권을 지킨다는 막중한 사명감을 가지고 한 치의 흔들림 없이, 어떠한 외부 압력에도 굴하지 않고 법에 따라 (특검팀을) 운영할 것”이라고 했다.)

The special prosecutor's activity period for the National Election Commission is up to 170 days, including a 20-day preparation period. A investigation team of up to 165 members can be formed, including 5 deputy special prosecutors and 70 special investigators. The scope of the special investigation covers "12 major allegations" concerning the overall operations of the National Election Commission, and since related cases newly discovered during the investigation can also be investigated under the special prosecution act, the scope of the investigation could expand. (선관위 특검의 활동기간은 준비기간 20일을 포함해 최장 170일이다. 특검보 5명과 특별수사관 70명 등 최대 165명 규모 수사팀을 꾸릴 수 있다. 특검 대상은 선관위 조직 운영 전반에 걸친 ‘12대 의혹’인데, 특검법상 수사 과정에서 새롭게 인지한 관련 사건도 수사할 수 있어 수사 대상이 확대될 가능성도 있다.)

Meanwhile, the recount of ballots at the Jamsil Olympic Park counting center, tentatively agreed upon by the ruling and opposition parties for the 18th, fell through. In July, the floor leadership of both parties had agreed, while extending the activity period of the special committee for the parliamentary investigation into the June 3 local election ballot shortage by 30 days, to conduct on-site verification of the ballot recount at the Olympic Park counting center on the 18th, but the People Power Party reportedly opposed it, saying, "The public recount should be conducted jointly by the special prosecutor for the National Election Commission and the parliamentary special committee." (한편, 여야가 18일로 잠정 합의했던 잠실 올림픽공원 내 투표지 재검표는 불발됐다. 앞서 지난 7월 여야 원내지도부는 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 국정조사특별위원회의 활동 기간을 30일 연장하면서 올림픽공원 개표소 투표지 재검표 현장검증을 18일 실시하기로 합의했는데, 국민의힘은 “선관위 특검과 국조특위가 함께 공개 재검표를 해야 한다”며 반대한 것으로 알려졌다.)

On the 18th, officials from the United Nations Command held a 50th anniversary memorial ceremony for the 'Panmunjom Axe Incident' at Camp Bonifas, a US military base in Paju, Gyeonggi Province. item.title: People Power Party's Anti-Lee Jae-myung Sentiment Grows Ominous... Third-Term Meeting Followed by Fourth-Term Gathering Announced (국힘, 反張 기류 심상찮다… 3선 이어 4선도 회동 예고)
item.description:
People Power Party's Anti-Lee Jae-myung Sentiment Grows Ominous... Third-Term Meeting Followed by Fourth-Term Gathering Announced (국힘, 反張 기류 심상찮다… 3선 이어 4선도 회동 예고)

Senior lawmakers of the People Power Party are pushing for successive meetings ahead of the first anniversary of Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's leadership. After Jang announced plans to unveil a party reform proposal centered on "party member-centric" principles and hinted at the possibility of a large-scale replacement of district party chairpersons, senior lawmakers have begun discussions on countermeasures. Many senior lawmakers are said to hold the stance that "winning the 2028 general election will be difficult under Representative Jang's hardline supporter-focused approach." (국민의힘 중진 의원들이 장동혁 대표 취임 1년을 앞두고 연이어 회동을 추진하고 있다. 장 대표가 ‘당원 중심’을 골자로 한 당 쇄신안 발표를 예고한 데 이어 당협위원장 대거 교체 가능성을 시사하자, 중진 의원들이 대책 논의에 나선 것이다. 중진 의원 다수는 “강성 지지층 중심의 장 대표 노선으로는 2028년 총선 승리가 어렵다”는 입장인 것으로 알려졌다.)

Third-term lawmakers, including floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik, gathered at a Chinese restaurant in Yeouido, Seoul on the 17th for a three-hour closed-door dinner meeting. Kim Seong-won, the coordinator of the third-term group, told the press immediately after the meeting, "The main discussion was about rallying support for Floor Leader Jeong and overcoming the crisis with him at the center." This message came from a gathering where 13 of the 14 third-term lawmakers from various factions, including former pro-Yoon, pro-Han, and non-mainstream groups, attended. One attendee said, "The call to rally around Floor Leader Jeong was essentially a declaration to sideline Representative Jang," adding, "Kim delivered that message with the consent of attendees, but in the actual meeting, more direct remarks were made, such as 'It will be difficult to contest the 2028 general election and the 2030 presidential election under Representative Jang's approach,' and a considerable number of lawmakers agreed with that sentiment." (국민의힘 정점식 원내대표를 비롯한 3선 의원들은 17일 서울 여의도의 한 중식당에 모여 3시간 동안 비공개 만찬 회동을 했다. 3선 모임 간사인 김성원 의원은 회동 직후 언론에 “정 원내대표에게 힘을 모아주고, 정 원내대표를 중심으로 위기를 극복하자는 이야기가 주를 이뤘다”고 밝혔다. 옛 친윤계, 친한계, 비주류 등 다양한 계파에 속한 3선 의원 14명 중 13명이 참석한 자리에서 나온 메시지였다. 한 참석자는 “정 원내대표를 중심으로 가자는 건 사실상 장 대표를 배제하자는 뜻이 담긴 선언”이라며 “김 의원이 참석자들의 동의를 얻어 이 같은 메시지를 냈지만, 실제 회동에서는 ‘장 대표 노선으로는 2028년 총선과 2030년 대선을 치르기 어렵다’는 식의 더 직설적인 얘기가 나왔고, 이에 동의한 의원이 상당수였다”고 전했다.)

Lawmakers with four or more terms are also expected to hold a closed-door meeting on the 20th. A fourth-term lawmaker leading this gathering said, "It may be difficult to issue a statement in the form of a resolution right away, but since there's a consensus that 'we can't contest the election like this,' shouldn't we at least exchange opinions?" A senior lawmaker from a non-Yeongnam region pointed to Jang's push for disciplinary action targeting non-mainstream factions and his focus on attending the Olympic Park rally sparked by the ballot shortage during the June 3 local elections, saying, "It's time to kick-start a conservative grand alliance, but I don't know what Representative Jang is doing." (4선 이상 의원들도 오는 20일 비공개 회동을 할 것으로 알려졌다. 이번 모임을 주도하는 한 4선 의원은 “당장 결의문 형태의 메시지를 내긴 어렵겠지만, ‘이대로는 총선 치르기 어렵다’는 공감대가 형성된 이상 의견이라도 나눠봐야 하지 않겠느냐”고 했다. 비(非)영남권 한 중진 의원은 장 대표가 비당권파를 겨냥한 징계를 추진하고, 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태로 촉발된 올림픽공원 집회 참석에 몰두하는 것을 지적하면서 “이제는 보수 대연합에 시동을 걸어야 할 때인데 장 대표가 뭘 하는지 모르겠다”고 했다.)

However, there are forecasts that senior lawmakers will find it difficult to secure momentum for party reform, as they have not presented viable alternatives to steer Representative Jang away from his current course or push for leadership change. Some within the party say, "Some lawmakers hoping to receive party posts, nominations, or constituencies from Representative Jang are either siding with him or staying silent, making it harder to redefine party leadership." (하지만 중진 의원들도 장 대표의 노선 전환을 이끌거나 리더십 교체를 추진할 만한 마땅한 대안을 내놓지는 못하면서 당 쇄신 동력을 확보하기는 쉽지 않을 것이란 전망이 나온다. 당내 일각에서는 “장 대표로부터 당직, 공천, 지역구를 받으려는 일부 의원이 동조하거나 침묵하면서 당 리더십 재정립이 더 어려워지고 있다”는 말도 나온다.)

Representative Jang has dismissed calls for resignation even after the June 3 local election defeat and continues to adhere to a hardline supporter-focused approach, while lawmakers aspiring for party positions and nominations are showing favorable attitudes toward him. At the closed-door meeting of third-term lawmakers, there was consensus to deliver the message to the press about "overcoming the crisis with Floor Leader Jeong at the center," but a lawmaker whom Jang was reportedly considering for the policy committee chairmanship expressed opposition. This has led to a sense of helplessness among senior lawmakers, with some saying, "For now, changing the Jang system is difficult." (장 대표는 6·3 지방선거 패배 이후에도 사퇴론을 일축하고 강성 지지층 중심 노선을 고수하는 데다, 당직과 공천 등을 희망하는 의원들이 장 대표에게 우호적인 태도를 보이고 있다. 3선 의원 비공개 회동에서 언론에 ‘정 원내대표 중심으로 위기를 극복하자’는 메시지를 내자는 뜻이 모였는데, 장 대표가 정책위의장으로 염두에 둔 것으로 알려진 모 의원이 반대 의사를 밝힌 것으로 전해졌다. 이 때문에 중진 의원들 사이에서는 “당분간은 장 대표 체제를 바꾸기 어렵다”는 무력감도 감지된다.)

A fourth-term lawmaker with less factional coloring said, "Even if we convey the opinions from the senior lawmakers' meetings to Representative Jang, I don't think it will make any difference. He doesn't even try to listen to senior voices, and if you say anything mildly critical, his supporters send text message bombs. It's frustrating." A senior lawmaker from the South Gyeongsang region said, "If the Seoul mayoral by-election materializes next April, some senior lawmakers seeking that nomination, first- and second-term lawmakers eyeing key party posts, and first-term proportional representatives wanting constituencies are staying silent or siding with the Jang system, making party reform harder. Just look at some of the fourth-term or higher lawmakers—aren't they aligning with Representative Jang's approach with an eye on running for Seoul mayor?" (계파색이 옅은 한 4선 의원은 “중진 의원 모임에서 나온 의견을 장 대표에게 전달하더라도 별 소용이 없다고 생각한다”며 “장 대표는 중진 목소리를 들으려 하지도 않고, 조금만 싫은 소리를 하면 장 대표 지지자들이 ‘문자 폭탄’을 보내지 않느냐. 답답하다”고 했다. 경남 지역 한 중진 의원은 “내년 4월 서울시장 보궐선거가 현실화하면 그 공천을 받고 싶어 하는 일부 중진, 주요 당직을 노리는 초·재선 의원들, 지역구를 받고 싶어 하는 초선 비례대표들이 장 대표 체제에 침묵하거나 동조하면서 당 쇄신을 더 어렵게 하고 있다”며 “당장 4선 이상 의원 중 일부만 봐도 서울시장 출마를 염두에 두고 장 대표 노선에 동조하는 것 아니냐”고 했다.)

A senior lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area said, "Even if senior lawmakers collectively flex their muscles, if Representative Jang, using hardline supporters as a shield, doesn't step down voluntarily, we'll just look foolish. So there's a widespread wait-and-see attitude of 'someone will take the lead' or 'something will change by year-end.'" (수도권 지역 한 중진 의원은 “중진 의원들이 단체로 실력 행사에 나선다고 하더라도, 강성 지지층을 방패막이로 삼은 장 대표가 자진 사퇴하지 않으면 우리만 바보 된다”며 “그러다 보니 다들 ‘누군가 총대를 메겠지’ ‘연말에는 어떻게 되겠지’라는 식으로 관망하는 분위기가 만연해 있다”고 했다.)

An aide to Representative Jang said, "Senior lawmakers aren't doing any real fight against the opposition, and now they're shaking the Jang system because they're worried about not getting nominations in the next general election. Isn't the special counsel on the election commission ultimately a achievement Jang secured by attending the Olympic Park rally every day?" (장 대표 측 인사는 “중진 의원들이 제대로 된 대여 투쟁은 하지도 않으면서 다음 총선에서 공천받기 어려울 것 같으니 장 대표 체제를 흔들고 있다”며 “선관위 특검도 결국 장 대표가 매일같이 올림픽공원 집회에 참석하며 얻어낸 성과 아니냐”고 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party Ethics Committee to Discipline Four Non-Pro-Power Figures Soon... Will Internal Conflict Ignite Again? (국힘 윤리위, 조만간 비당권파 4인 징계… 당내 갈등 또 불붙나)
item.description:
People Power Party Ethics Committee to Discipline Four Non-Pro-Power Figures Soon... Will Internal Conflict Ignite Again? (국힘 윤리위, 조만간 비당권파 4인 징계… 당내 갈등 또 불붙나)

The People Power Party's Ethics Committee summoned lawmakers Cho Kyung-tae, Kwon Young-jin, Seo Beom-soo, and Jin Jong-oh, whose disciplinary proceedings had been initiated, to the party headquarters in Yeouido on the 18th to hear their explanations regarding the disciplinary review matters. With the Ethics Committee planning to decide the level of discipline for these lawmakers soon, some of those subject to discipline are pushing back, arguing, "Why aren't the pro-power faction members being disciplined?" — a sign that internal conflict is escalating. (국민의힘 윤리위원회가 18일 징계 절차가 개시된 당 조경태·권영진·서범수·진종오 의원을 서울 여의도 당사로 불러 징계 심의 사안에 대한 소명을 들었다. 윤리위가 조만간 이들에 대한 징계 수위를 결정할 방침인 가운데 일부 징계 대상자는 “당권파들은 왜 징계를 하지 않느냐”며 반발하고 나서면서 당내 갈등이 증폭되는 모양새다.)

The Ethics Committee held a meeting around 3 p.m. that day and heard their explanations with the lawmakers present in person. Representative Cho, the most senior lawmaker in the party, was referred to the Ethics Committee for appealing to other party lawmakers to vote against Park Deok-heum, the National Assembly's vice speaker from the People Power Party, in the election. Representative Kwon faced disciplinary proceedings after being assigned as the opposition party's secretary on the Public Administration and Security Committee last month and, frustrated by this, visited the office of floor leader Chung Jeom-sik and grabbed him by the collar. Representatives Seo and Jin were cited for making inappropriate remarks at a meeting attended by the victim of the 'Busan spinning kick' assault case. Separately, Representative Jin was also referred to the Ethics Committee for assisting Han Dong-hoon, who ran as an independent in the June 3 election. (윤리위는 이날 오후 3시쯤 회의를 열고 이들 의원이 직접 참석한 가운데 소명을 들었다. 당 내 최다선인 조 의원은 다른 당 의원들에게 국민의힘 박덕흠 국회부의장의 낙선을 호소했다는 이유로 윤리위에 제소됐다. 권 의원은 지난달 행정안전위원회 야당 간사로 배치된 뒤 이에 대한 불만을 품고 정점식 원내대표실을 찾아가 정 원내대표의 멱살을 잡았다는 이유로 징계 절차가 개시됐다. 서 의원과 진 의원은 ‘부산 돌려차기’ 사건 피해자가 참석한 간담회에서 실언을 한 이유다. 이와 별개로 진 의원은 지난 6·3 선거에서 무소속으로 출마한 한동훈 의원을 도왔다는 이유로도 윤리위에 제소됐다.)

The lawmakers are known to have explained that the discipline is unjust. After the Ethics Committee's disciplinary review, Representative Cho met with reporters and said, "It was an act to uphold the Constitution of the Republic of Korea and protect democracy," adding, "I explained that the People Power Party can never achieve power under the current leadership of Representative Chang Dong-hyuk." After the review, Representative Jin expressed dissatisfaction with the committee's questioning style that day, stating, "The chairman's remarks, implying 'Can't you understand Korean?' were quite offensive," and announced he would file a request for recusal against the Ethics Committee. Meanwhile, the victim of the Busan spinning kick case is known to have submitted a petition to the Ethics Committee asking for leniency toward Representatives Seo and Jin. (이들은 징계가 부당하다는 취지로 소명한 것으로 알려졌다. 조 의원은 윤리위 징계 심의를 마치고 기자들과 만나 “대한민국 헌법을 지키고 민주주의를 지키려 했던 일”이라며 “국민의힘이 지금의 장동혁 대표 체제로는 절대로 정권을 창출할 수 없다는 취지로 소명했다”고 말했다. 진 의원은 이날 윤리위 징계 심의를 마친 뒤 윤리위의 이날 질의 방식에 대해 “위원장의 ‘한국말을 못 알아듣냐’는 식의 발언이 상당히 불쾌했다”며 윤리위에 기피신청서를 제출하겠다”고 밝혔다. 한편 부산 돌려차기 피해자는 윤리위에 서·진 의원에 대한 선처를 호소하는 탄원서를 제출한 것으로 알려졌다.)

There are also analyses suggesting that the disciplinary outcomes for the four lawmakers could amplify internal conflict. Although the four were referred to the Ethics Committee over different controversies, they are all classified as non-pro-power figures who have been demanding Chairman Chang's resignation. In particular, Representative Cho, referred to the disciplinary committee that day, had argued the previous day, "Expel Representative Lee Jin-sook, who insulted the spirit of the May 18 Gwangju Uprising and trampled on the party's platform, constitution, and rules." Representative Lee had held an academic forum on the May 18 Gwangju Democratization Movement with a right-wing group on the 13th, and a figure attending the event referred to the May 18 Democratization Movement as a 'riot' incident, sparking controversy. That day, Senior Spokesperson Park Choong-kwon met with reporters and drew a line, saying, "The party cannot intervene in a lawmaker's decision to hold a seminar as an individual constitutional institution," confirming there was no intention to discipline. (의원 4명의 징계 결과에 따라 당내 갈등이 증폭될 수 있다는 분석도 나온다. 네 의원은 각기 다른 논란으로 윤리위에 회부됐지만 장 대표 사퇴를 요구해온 비당권파로 분류된다. 특히 이날 징계위에 회부된 조 의원은 앞서 전날 “5·18 광주 오월 정신을 모욕하며 당의 강령과 당헌·당규를 짓밟은 이진숙 의원을 제명하라”고 주장했다. 이 의원이 지난 13일 우파 단체와 5·18 광주민주화운동 관련 학술 토론회를 열었고, 이 행사에 참석한 한 인사는 5·18 민주화운동을 ‘소요 사태’로 표현해 논란이 됐다. 이날 박충권 수석대변인은 기자들과 만나 “국회의원 개인이 헌법기관으로 세미나를 개최하는 부분에 대해 당이 관여할 수 있는 사안이 아니다”라고 선을 그으며 징계 의사가 없다는 것을 확인했다.)

item.title: Special Act on Yongsan Park Development... Ruling Party and Government to Discuss Amendment Today (용산공원 개발 특별법… 당정, 오늘 개정 협의)
item.description:
Special Act on Yongsan Park Development... Ruling Party and Government to Discuss Amendment Today (용산공원 개발 특별법… 당정, 오늘 개정 협의)

The government and the ruling party are known to hold a party-government consultation on the 19th to discuss housing supply measures, including the development of Yongsan Park. At the meeting, they plan to discuss whether to pass the "Special Act on Yongsan Park Creation Amendment" at the plenary session of the National Assembly on the 20th, which would ease development standards for sites around Yongsan Park, such as Camp Kim. However, utilizing Yongsan Children's Garden, which the government has announced plans to use for youth rental housing, would require separate legislation. Meanwhile, the Seoul Metropolitan Government and others are opposing the amendment, questioning whether it is intended to use the revision as a stepping stone to accelerate Yongsan Park development. <<> Democratic Party lawmakers on the Land, Infrastructure and Transport Committee and senior officials from the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport held a party-government consultation on the morning of the 19th to discuss follow-up measures related to the government's housing supply plan announced on the 13th. A Democratic Party official said, "Since the government officially announced its policy to consider Yongsan Park as a candidate site for housing supply, opposition from the Seoul Metropolitan Government and residents has continued, so we will also review the details and public opinion." <<> The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport is preparing a plan to supply housing for young people and newlyweds in the Yongsan Park area. While plans to utilize approximately 5-10% of the entire Yongsan Park as residential land are under review, the Children's Garden, spanning 300,000 square meters (about 97,500 pyeong), is reportedly being considered as a strong candidate. The presidential office has also decided to review plans to build public rental housing for young people at the Children's Garden and will launch a public discourse process to gather public opinion. <<> Since Yongsan Park is a site designated as a national park under the Special Act on Yongsan Park Creation enacted in 2007, building housing there requires amending the law. The amendment includes provisions to ease requirements for securing parks and green spaces in surrounding complex facility districts such as Camp Kim. The bill was approved by the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee in May and is awaiting passage at the plenary session. However, since this bill targets the complex facilities around the park, it is separate from the Children's Garden, which is currently under controversy. <<> Han Byung-do, the Democratic Party's floor leader, said at the party's floor strategy meeting that day, "The most urgent priority is legislation to support housing supply," citing the Urban Regeneration Act and the Public Housing Act as bills to be processed at the plenary session on the 20th. A ruling party official said, "Since a meeting between Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Yun-deok and Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon is scheduled on the day of the plenary session, whether to bring the special act to the plenary session will be decided after discussions with the government, the Seoul Metropolitan Government, and others." (정부와 여당은 19일 당·정 협의를 갖고 용산공원 개발 등 주택 공급 방안을 논의할 것으로 알려졌다. 이날 회의에선 오는 20일 국회 본회의에서 캠프킴 등 용산공원 주변 부지의 개발 기준을 완화하는 ‘용산공원조성특별법 개정안’을 처리할지 여부도 논의하겠다는 방침이다. 다만 현재 정부가 청년 임대주택을 짓겠다고 밝힌 용산어린이정원 활용을 위해선 별도의 입법을 거쳐야 한다. 그러나 서울시 등은 “이번 특별법 개정안을 발판삼아 용산공원 개발을 본격화하려는 것 아니냐”며 처리에 반대하고 있다.)
